selectionNotes: Selected existing genera with a named specimen. Troodon excluded because of later reassignment; Yutyrannus multiple specimen entry excluded. Left/right reflection is inferred except explicitly measured Stegosaurus left femur and tibia. Historical specimen names retained as printed.
